name: Visigoths
alt: Gothic army of Alaric and Athaulf

predecessors.name: Eastern Roman Empire
predecessors.text: Thessaly, where Alaric's forces were sent after Theodosius's death in 395

successors.name: Visigothic Kingdom
successors.text: the Garonne valley of Gallia Aquitania in which Honorius settled Wallia's federates in 418: 'the Visigoths were settled as foederati in southern Gaul, establishing a kingdom with its capital at…

ledger.x: 395: the Goths are united under Alaric.
396: the Goths leave Thessaly for the south.
396: Alaric plunders Greece.
397: Stilicho drives the Goths out of the south.
397: Alaric is named military commander of Illyricum.
401: the Goths leave Epirus for Italy.
402: Alaric invades Italy.
402: Alaric withdraws from Italy.
403: the Goths settle in Pannonia.
407: Alaric leaves Pannonia.
407: Alaric takes a position in Noricum.
408: Alaric marches from Noricum on Rome.
408: Alaric besieges Rome.
410: the Goths ravage the south of Italy.
410: Alaric sacks Rome and leaves.
412: Athaulf leads the Goths out of Italy.
413: the Goths hold Narbonne and Toulouse.
414: Athaulf proclaims Attalus at Bordeaux.
415: the Goths leave Gaul.
415: the Goths are at Barcelona.
417: Wallia's Goths leave the Barcelona area for the south.
417: Wallia's Goths fall on the Vandals in Baetica.
417: Wallia's Goths fall on the Alans in Lusitania.
418: Constantius recalls the Goths.
418: the Goths leave Lusitania.
418: Honorius settles the Goths in Aquitaine.

wars.name: Gothic campaign in Greece
wars.outcome: Alaric sacked Athens in 396 and plundered the Peloponnese until Stilicho's surprise attack pushed him north into Epirus; in 397 Arcadius made him military commander of Illyricum.

wars.name: Alaric's invasion of Italy
wars.outcome: Stilicho beat Alaric at Pollentia (Easter 402) and at Verona; Alaric withdrew into Pannonia.

wars.name: Alaric's march on Rome
wars.outcome: Siege in late 408 ended with a ransom (December 408); the second siege from late 409 made Priscus Attalus emperor; Rome was sacked on 24-26 August 410 and the Goths went south.

wars.name: Athaulf's war in Gaul
wars.outcome: Athaulf took Narbonne and Toulouse (413), captured Jovinus at Valence, executed Sarus, married Galla Placidia (January 414), proclaimed Attalus at Bordeaux (414) and withdrew into Hispania in 415.

wars.name: Wallia's campaign in Hispania
wars.outcome: As Honorius's federates Wallia's Goths fought the Alans and Vandals in Baetica and Lusitania (the Alan ruler Addax was killed) and were recalled in 418, to be settled in Aquitaine.

certainty.note: An army and its people on the move: every shape is a presence zone, never a surveyed border; the 418 Aquitaine grant (visigothic-kingdom) is the first fixed ground.
